names.note: Read out of saint.gr's list of the twelve hierarchs of Novgorod on the page for 10 Φεβρουαρίου, «Γεννάδιος (κοιμήθηκε 1505 μ.Χ.)», with the rank word left off.

Read out of the Охридски пролог’s heading for 4. децембар ст. ст., „Свети Генадије, архиепископ новгородски.“ — with «Свети» (“saint”) and «архиепископ новгородски» left off, the latter being a rank and a see, which §6 keeps out of a stored form and which this corpus puts in `types` and the display name instead. That leaves the bare forename. `sr-foldpred.mjs` measured the folded string at 0 other holders, which is worth saying because the corpus holds ten Gennadius folders: none of them stores a Serbian form, and the fold the gate would make is of this string and not of the English name.

source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 10ης Φεβρουαρίου — «Άγιοι Πάντες Ιεράρχες εν Νόβγκοροντ της Ρωσίας»

attestations.note: One of twelve hierarchs of Novgorod whom the page enumerates by name, each with the year of his repose; his is 1505. The page also keeps the same synaxis on 4 October and on the third Sunday after Pentecost, which are not this row's feast. saint.gr calls the twelve Ιεράρχες and gives no see-rank for him individually.

source.text: Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 17.12.2025 (4. децембар ст. ст.) — „Свети Генадије, архиепископ новгородски.“

attestations.note: The day’s third entry, quoted whole with its closing full stop; URL year 2025. A DIFFERENT DAY FROM THE ONE THE CORPUS HELD, and it is a day of his own rather than a company: the Greek calendar keeps him on 10 February inside the synaxis of the twelve hierarchs of Novgorod, and this book gives him his own entry on the Julian 4 December. The serbian row was `undocumented`, so the row simply lands; the greek row is untouched and stays on 10 February. `types_add`: `archbishop`, which the heading states outright — «архиепископ новгородски» — where the folder held the generic `hierarch` it got from a Greek enumeration that named only his see and his year. NO `office`: `i18n.test.mjs` wants every office string in all four locale packs and “Archbishop of Novgorod” is not in them, so the see stays in the display name and the life. `dates` UNTOUCHED and it is an AGREEMENT: «Упокојио се у Господу 1505. године», which is the year saint.gr’s enumeration gave and the folder already carries. WHAT THE BOOK ADDS IS EVERYTHING THE GREEK PAGE SAID IT DID NOT HAVE — that page recorded „the name, the see and the year, and nothing else“, and this entry gives him three things besides: that he was a notable writer and a champion of and sufferer for the truth of Christ; that he gathered the scattered books of Holy Scripture together into one; that he composed a paschal key for five hundred and thirty-two years ahead; and that his wonderworking relics are in the Chudov monastery in Moscow. NO `locations`. NO `related` row: the entry names nobody else. The Prologue prints no troparion and no kontakion.
